1 Data Cleaning

1.1 CMF Credit Registry

The CMF credit registry (cmf_project_2011-2024.dta) contains the universe of corporate loans issued by Chilean banks. We keep only firms matched with the SII tax registry (mergeC11D03 == 3), construct the new-credit variable as the positive first difference in outstanding loan balances at the bank–firm–month level, and collapse to annual frequency.

Show code 
# ── 1. Load ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cmf_raw <- read_dta(din("Base Final/cmf_project_2011-2024.dta"))

# ── 2. Keep matched firms only ────────────────────────────────────────────────
cmf <- cmf_raw |>
  filter(mergeC11D03 == 3, c11_cartera_normal > 0) |>
  select(-mergeC11D03)

# ── 3. Parse year from periodo (YYYYMM) ───────────────────────────────────────
cmf <- cmf |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(substr(as.character(periodo), 1, 4)))

# ── 4. Build bank-firm-year NEW CREDIT flow ───────────────────────────────────
# New credit is the positive monthly change in outstanding balance.
cmf_annual <- cmf |>
  group_by(id, ins_cod) |>
  arrange(periodo, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    newcred_cartera = pmax(c11_cartera_normal - lag(c11_cartera_normal), 0),
    newcred_cartera = replace_na(newcred_cartera, 0)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(id, ins_cod, year, región, subrubroeconómico) |>
  summarise(
    newcred_cartera = sum(newcred_cartera,         na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_colat       = mean(c11_deducido_expos_garanreal +
                           c11_deducido_expos_garfinanc, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_cat         = mean(d03_cat_deudor,         na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # log1p para incluir ceros
    lnewcred = log1p(newcred_cartera)
  )

1.2 Regional IDs and Court Entry Dates

We assign numeric region IDs and code the staggered court entry year (year_court). Three environmental courts were established under Law No. 20,600:

Court Regions Entry year
Santiago 5, 6, 7, 13, 16 2013
Valdivia 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14 2014
Antofagasta 1, 2, 3, 4, 15 2017
Show code 
region_lookup <- tribble(
  ~región,                                                          ~regid,
  "I REGION DE TARAPACA",                                              1L,
  "II REGION DE ANTOFAGASTA",                                          2L,
  "III REGION DE ATACAMA",                                             3L,
  "IV REGION COQUIMBO",                                                4L,
  "V REGION VALPARAISO",                                               5L,
  "VI REGION DEL LIBERTADOR GENERAL BERNARDO O'HIGGINS",               6L,
  "VII REGION DEL MAULE",                                              7L,
  "VIII REGION DEL BIO BIO",                                           8L,
  "IX REGION DE LA ARAUCANIA",                                         9L,
  "X REGION LOS LAGOS",                                               10L,
  "XI REGION AYSEN DEL GENERAL CARLOS IBAÑEZ DEL CAMPO",             11L,
  "XII REGION DE MAGALLANES Y LA ANTARTICA CHILENA",                  12L,
  "XIII REGION METROPOLITANA",                                        13L,
  "XIV REGION DE LOS RIOS",                                           14L,
  "XV REGION ARICA Y PARINACOTA",                                     15L,
  "XVI REGION DE ÑUBLE",                                              16L
)

court_lookup <- tribble(
  ~regid, ~year_court,
  # Santiago court — January 2013
   5L, 2013L,  6L, 2013L,  7L, 2013L, 13L, 2013L, 16L, 2013L,
  # Valdivia court — December 2013 (first full year = 2014)
   8L, 2014L,  9L, 2014L, 10L, 2014L, 11L, 2014L, 12L, 2014L, 14L, 2014L,
  # Antofagasta court — July 2017
   1L, 2017L,  2L, 2017L,  3L, 2017L,  4L, 2017L, 15L, 2017L
)

cmf_annual <- cmf_annual |>
  left_join(region_lookup, by = "región") |>
  left_join(court_lookup,  by = "regid") |>
  mutate(
    # never-treated = 0 (required by the did package)
    year_court = replace_na(year_court, 0L),
    court      = as.integer(year_court > 0 & year >= year_court)
  )

1.3 SMA Enforcement Cases

Show code 
sma_raw <- read_dta(din("cmf_project_super_intendencia.dta")) |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))  # viene como string, hay que convertir

# Construir regid desde region (string) usando el mismo lookup de arriba
region_lookup_sma <- tribble(
  ~region,                                                              ~regid,
  "Región de Tarapacá",                                                     1L,
  "Región de Antofagasta",                                                   2L,
  "Región de Atacama",                                                       3L,
  "Región de Coquimbo",                                                      4L,
  "Región de Valparaíso",                                                    5L,
  "Región del Libertador General Bernardo O'Higgins",                        6L,
  "Región del Maule",                                                        7L,
  "Región del Biobío",                                                       8L,
  "Región de la Araucanía",                                                  9L,
  "Región de los Lagos",                                                    10L,
  "Región de Aysén del General Carlos Ibáñez del Campo",                   11L,
  "Región de Magallanes y la Antártica Chilena",                           12L,
  "Región Metropolitana",                                                   13L,
  "Región de Los Ríos",                                                     14L,
  "Región de Arica y Parinacota",                                           15L,
  "Región de Ñuble",                                                        16L
)

# Contar casos por region-year y calcular lrcases (lag log)
reg_cases <- sma_raw |>
  left_join(region_lookup_sma, by = "region") |>
  filter(!is.na(regid)) |>
  group_by(regid, year) |>
  summarise(cases = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(regid, year) |>
  group_by(regid) |>
  mutate(lrcases = lag(log1p(cases))) |>   # one-year lag, as in paper
  ungroup()

# Merge into annual panel
cmf_annual <- cmf_annual |>
  left_join(reg_cases |> select(regid, year, lrcases),
            by = c("regid", "year")) |>
  mutate(lrcases = replace_na(lrcases, 0))

cat("SMA cases merged. Regions covered:", n_distinct(reg_cases$regid), "\n")
SMA cases merged. Regions covered: 16
Show code 
cat("Years covered:", paste(range(reg_cases$year, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = "-"), "\n")

1.5 Final Working Sample

Show code 
df <- cmf_annual |>
  filter(!is.na(regid), !is.na(score_share)) |>
  filter(regid != 13) |>
  mutate(
    lnewcred_w  = Winsorize(lnewcred,
                            quantile(lnewcred, probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
                                     na.rm = TRUE)),
    bankfirm_id = as.integer(interaction(ins_cod, id, drop = TRUE)),
    IDB         = as.integer(factor(ins_cod)),
    IDR         = as.integer(factor(regid)),
    IDS         = as.integer(factor(subrubroeconómico))
  )

# ── Define never-treated following the paper's approach ───────────────────────
# Firms in sectors with score_share < 0.2 are assigned year_court = 0
# (never-treated) because environmental courts are unlikely to affect
# sectors with negligible environmental impact.
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    year_court = if_else(score_share < 0.2, 0L, year_court),
    court      = if_else(score_share < 0.2, 0L, court)
  )

# ── Fix: year_court must be time-invariant per bankfirm_id ────────────────────
# Some pairs change region or score_share across years (~2% of sample).
# We assign the modal (most frequent) year_court value per pair.
year_court_fixed <- df |>
  group_by(bankfirm_id) |>
  summarise(
    year_court = as.integer(names(which.max(table(year_court)))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df <- df |>
  select(-year_court) |>
  left_join(year_court_fixed, by = "bankfirm_id")

# ── Verify cohort distribution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── Build df_cs ready for Callaway-Sant'Anna ───────────────────────────────────
df_cs <- df |>
  filter(!is.na(lnewcred_w), !is.na(lrcases), !is.na(score_share)) |>
  mutate(year_court = as.integer(year_court))

# Final check: no pair should have more than one year_court value
inconsistent <- df_cs |>
  group_by(bankfirm_id) |>
  summarise(n_values = n_distinct(year_court), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_values > 1) |>
  nrow()

2.2 New Credit Over Time by ENCORE Group

Show code 
credit_ts <- df |>
  filter(!is.na(d50_score)) |>
  group_by(year, d50_score) |>
  summarise(total = sum(exp(lnewcred_w), na.rm = TRUE) / 1e9, .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(group = if_else(d50_score == 1, "High ENCORE", "Low ENCORE"))

ymax <- max(credit_ts$total, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(credit_ts, aes(year, total, colour = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(2013, 2014, 2017),
             linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5, colour = col_court) +
  annotate("text", x = c(2013.15, 2014.15, 2017.15),
           y = ymax * c(0.95, 0.85, 0.75),
           label = c("Santiago\ncourt", "Valdivia\ncourt", "Antofagasta\ncourt"),
           size = 3, hjust = 0, colour = col_court) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(col_high, col_low)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(suffix = "B CLP")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2011:2024) +
  labs(
    title    = "New Credit by ENCORE Exposure Group",
    subtitle = "High ENCORE = sectors above median ENCORE score",
    x = NULL, y = "Aggregate new credit (billions CLP)",
    colour = NULL

3 Baseline TWFE Replication

We replicate the paper’s two main specifications using fixest::feols().

3.1 Equation 1 — SMA Cases × ENCORE Score

\[\text{Loan}_{i,j,r,s,t} = \alpha_0 + \beta_1 \text{Cases}_{r,t-1} + \beta_2 \text{Score}_s + \beta_3(\text{Cases}_{r,t-1} \times \text{Score}_s) + \mu_{ij} + \delta_{st} + \omega_{jt} + u\]

Show code 
df_high <- df |>
  filter(score_share >= quantile(score_share, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))

# Table 2 replication: cases only, high-ENCORE sample
m2_1 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) | bankfirm_id,
              data = df_high, cluster = ~IDR)
m2_2 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) | bankfirm_id + IDS^year,
              data = df_high, cluster = ~IDR)
m2_3 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) | bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df_high, cluster = ~IDR)

# Table 3 replication: interaction with continuous ENCORE score
m3_1 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * score_share | bankfirm_id,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)
m3_2 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * score_share | bankfirm_id + IDS^year,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)
m3_3 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * score_share |
                bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)

modelsummary(
  list("(1)" = m2_1, "(2)" = m2_2, "(3)" = m2_3,
       "(4)" = m3_1, "(5)" = m3_2, "(6)" = m3_3),
  title    = "Tables 2-3 Replication: Effect of SMA Cases on New Credit",
  stars    = c("*" = 0.1, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01),
  coef_map = c(
    "log1p(lrcases)"             = "Log Cases (lag)",
    "score_share"                = "ENCORE score",
    "log1p(lrcases):score_share" = "Log Cases × ENCORE"
  ),
  gof_map  = c("nobs", "r.squared"),
  notes    = "Clustered SE by region only. Cols 1-3: above-p25 ENCORE sample.",
  output   = "kableExtra"
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     "Table 2: Cases only (above-p25 ENCORE)" = 3,
                     "Table 3: Cases × ENCORE (full sample)" = 3)) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

3.2 Equation 2 — Court Introduction × SMA Cases

\[\text{Loan}_{i,j,r,s,t} = \alpha_0 + \beta_1 \text{Cases}_{r,t-1} + \beta_2 \text{Court}_{r,t} + \beta_3(\text{Cases}_{r,t-1} \times \text{Court}_{r,t}) + \mu_{ij} + \delta_{st} + \omega_{jt} + u\]

The key coefficient is \(\beta_3\): it captures whether judicial enforceability amplifies the credit response to regulatory pressure.

Show code 
m4_1 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court | bankfirm_id + IDS^year,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)
m4_2 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court |
                bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)
m4_3 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court |
                bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df |> filter(d50_score == 1), cluster = ~IDR)
m4_4 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court |
                bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df |> filter(d50_score == 0), cluster = ~IDR)

modelsummary(
  list("Full (1)" = m4_1, "Full (2)" = m4_2,
       "High ENCORE" = m4_3, "Low ENCORE" = m4_4),
  title    = "Table 4 Replication: Court Introduction × SMA Cases",
  stars    = c("*" = 0.1, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01),
  coef_map = c(
    "log1p(lrcases)"       = "Log Cases (lag)",
    "court"                = "Court",
    "log1p(lrcases):court" = "Log Cases × Court"
  ),
  gof_map  = c("nobs", "r.squared"),
  notes    = "Clustered SE by region only. Santiago excluded.",
  output   = "kableExtra"
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Full sample" = 2, "By ENCORE exposure" = 2)) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

4 Callaway–Sant’Anna Staggered DiD

Standard TWFE can be biased when treatment effects are heterogeneous across cohorts, because it implicitly uses already-treated units as controls for later-treated units. The Callaway & Sant’Anna (2021) estimator avoids this by constructing clean 2×2 ATT(g,t) comparisons for each cohort \(g\) and period \(t\).

Setup:

  • Treatment: year_court — year the court became operational in the firm’s region (0 = never-treated)
  • Unit: bankfirm_id (bank–firm pair)
  • Controls: lrcases + score_share (to improve parallel trends plausibility)
  • Comparison group: not-yet-treated units (control_group = "notyettreated")
  • Method: doubly-robust (est_method = "dr")
Show code 
df_cs <- df |>
  filter(!is.na(lnewcred_w), !is.na(lrcases), !is.na(score_share)) |>
  mutate(year_court = as.integer(year_court))

# ── Aggregate to region-sector-year level for CS estimation ───────────────────
# CS requires a unit ID (rs_id) that is time-invariant; bank-firm pairs
# can move regions, so we collapse to region × sector.
df_rs_bal <- df_cs |>
  group_by(regid, subrubroeconómico, year) |>
  summarise(
    lnewcred_w  = mean(lnewcred_w,  na.rm = TRUE),
    lrcases     = first(lrcases),
    score_share = first(score_share),
    year_court  = first(year_court),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rs_id       = as.integer(interaction(regid, subrubroeconómico, drop = TRUE)),
    regid_fixed = regid
  )

# ── Fix: year_court must be time-invariant per rs_id ──────────────────────────
# Assign the modal year_court per region-sector to ensure irreversibility.
year_court_rs <- df_rs_bal |>
  group_by(rs_id) |>
  summarise(
    year_court = as.integer(names(which.max(table(year_court)))),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

df_rs_bal <- df_rs_bal |>
  select(-year_court) |>
  left_join(year_court_rs, by = "rs_id")

cat("CS sample:", nrow(df_cs), "obs |",
    n_distinct(df_cs$bankfirm_id), "bank-firm pairs\n\n")
CS sample: 474785 obs | 104770 bank-firm pairs

  distinct(bankfirm_id, year_court) |>
  count(year_court, name = "pairs") |>
  mutate(label = case_when(
    year_court == 0    ~ "Never treated",
    year_court == 2013 ~ "Santiago (g=2013)",
    year_court == 2014 ~ "Valdivia (g=2014)",
    year_court == 2017 ~ "Antofagasta (g=2017)"
  )) |>
  select(label, pairs) |>

# ── Helper: tidy a CS dynamic aggregate into a tibble ─────────────────────────
tidy_cs <- function(cs_dyn, label) {
  tibble(
    event_time = cs_dyn$egt,
    att        = cs_dyn$att.egt,
    se         = cs_dyn$se.egt,
    group      = label
  ) |>
    mutate(ci_lo = att - 1.96 * se,
           ci_hi = att + 1.96 * se)
}

4.4 Robustness: Control Group Definition

The main CS specification defines the control group as a mix of two types of units: (1) firms with score_share < 0.2 reclassified as never-treated (sector-based exclusion), and (2) firms in regions not yet treated at each calendar year (geographic not-yet-treated). These two groups are conceptually distinct. This section checks whether results are sensitive to which type of control group drives identification.

Three specifications are compared:

  • Baseline: never-treated (low ENCORE) + not-yet-treated (what the main spec uses)
  • Robustness A: only never-treated (low ENCORE firms, score_share < 0.2), using control_group = "nevertreated" — isolates purely sectoral variation
  • Robustness B: only not-yet-treated (geographic timing variation only), panel truncated to 2011–2016 to avoid the absence of controls for g=2017 after all regions are treated
Show code 
# ── Robustness A: solo never-treated (low ENCORE) como control ─────────────────
# Usa nevertreated en vez de notyettreated — solo variación sectorial
cs_robA <- att_gt(
  yname         = "lnewcred_w",
  tname         = "year",
  idname        = "rs_id",
  gname         = "year_court",
  xformla       = ~ 1,
  data          = df_rs_bal,
  control_group = "nevertreated",   # <-- cambio clave respecto al baseline
  est_method    = "reg",
  clustervars   = "regid_fixed",
  print_details = FALSE
)

# ── Robustness B: solo not-yet-treated (variación geográfica de timing) ────────
# Excluye las firmas never-treated artificiales (low ENCORE).
# Trunca el panel a 2011-2016 para evitar que g=2017 quede sin controles
# válidos una vez que Antofagasta se trata.
df_robB <- df_rs_bal |>
  filter(year <= 2016) |>        # antes de que todas las regiones estén tratadas
  filter(year_court != 0)        # excluye never-treated artificiales (low ENCORE)

cs_robB <- att_gt(
  yname         = "lnewcred_w",
  tname         = "year",
  idname        = "rs_id",
  gname         = "year_court",
  xformla       = ~ 1,
  data          = df_robB,
  control_group = "notyettreated",
  est_method    = "reg",
  clustervars   = "regid_fixed",
  print_details = FALSE
)

# ── Agregar ATT simples ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cs_robA_simple <- aggte(cs_robA, type = "simple")
cs_robB_simple <- aggte(cs_robB, type = "simple")

# ── Tabla comparativa ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rob_comp <- tribble(
  ~Specification,                        ~Control_group,                          ~ATT,                       ~SE,
  "Baseline (main)",                     "Low ENCORE (never) + not-yet-treated",  cs_simple$overall.att,      cs_simple$overall.se,
  "Robustness A: never-treated only",    "Low ENCORE only (score_share < 0.2)",   cs_robA_simple$overall.att, cs_robA_simple$overall.se,
  "Robustness B: not-yet-treated only",  "Not-yet-treated only (2011–2016)",       cs_robB_simple$overall.att, cs_robB_simple$overall.se
) |>
  mutate(
    ci_lo = round(ATT - 1.96 * SE, 4),
    ci_hi = round(ATT + 1.96 * SE, 4),
    ATT   = round(ATT, 4),
    SE    = round(SE,  4)
  )

rob_comp |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Robustness: Sensitivity to Control Group Definition",
    subtitle = "Are CS results driven by how the control group is constructed?"
  ) |>

  cols_label(

     absence of not-yet-treated units after g=2017 (Antofagasta) is treated.
     Robustness A uses nevertreated instead of notyettreated in att_gt()."
  )

How to read this: If Robustness A (never-treated only) and Baseline converge but Robustness B diverges, identification is coming primarily from sectoral variation (low ENCORE firms), not geographic timing. If Robustness B fails to run or has very wide CIs, that confirms the g=2017 identification problem: without not-yet-treated units after 2017, the geographic timing variation alone is weak for the Antofagasta cohort.

5 Wooldridge ETWFE — Robustness

As an additional robustness check we implement the Wooldridge (2021) Extended TWFE (ETWFE) estimator. This saturates interactions between cohort dummies, period dummies, and the continuous enforcement variable (lrcases), avoiding negative weighting while remaining in a familiar regression framework.

Show code 
df_w <- df |>
  mutate(
    d2013 = as.integer(year_court == 2013),
    d2014 = as.integer(year_court == 2014),
    d2017 = as.integer(year_court == 2017),
    dinf  = as.integer(year_court == 0),
    f2013 = as.integer(year == 2013),
    f2014 = as.integer(year == 2014),
    f2015 = as.integer(year == 2015),
    f2016 = as.integer(year == 2016),
    f2017 = as.integer(year == 2017),
    f2018 = as.integer(year == 2018),
    f2019 = as.integer(year == 2019),
    f2020 = as.integer(year == 2020),
    # Time-invariant region ID for clustering
    IDR_fixed = as.integer(factor(regid))
  )

# ── Mean-centre lrcases within each cohort (correct grouping) ─────────────────
mean_rc <- df_w |>
  group_by(year_court) |>
  summarise(mean_lrcases = mean(lrcases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_w <- df_w |>
  left_join(mean_rc, by = "year_court") |>
  mutate(
    rc_dm13 = if_else(d2013 == 1, lrcases - mean_lrcases, 0),
    rc_dm14 = if_else(d2014 == 1, lrcases - mean_lrcases, 0),
    rc_dm17 = if_else(d2017 == 1, lrcases - mean_lrcases, 0)
  ) |>
  select(-mean_lrcases)

# ── ETWFE: saturated cohort × period × cases interactions ─────────────────────
etwfe <- feols(
  lnewcred_w ~
    # Cohort 2013: post-treatment periods
    I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2013) + I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2014) +
    I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2015) + I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2016) +
    I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2017) + I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2018) +
    I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2019) + I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2020) +
    # Cohort 2014: post-treatment periods
    I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2014) + I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2015) +
    I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2016) + I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2017) +
    I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2018) + I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2019) +
    I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2020) +
    # Cohort 2017: post-treatment periods
    I(d2017 * rc_dm17 * f2017) + I(d2017 * rc_dm17 * f2018) +
    I(d2017 * rc_dm17 * f2019) + I(d2017 * rc_dm17 * f2020) |
    bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
  data    = df_w,
  cluster = ~IDR_fixed
)

# ── Compute weighted average ATT across cohort-period cells ───────────────────
etwfe_coefs <- coef(etwfe)

df_es <- cmf_annual |>
  # Solo excluir filas sin región o sin ENCORE — mantener RM
  filter(!is.na(regid), !is.na(score_share)) |>
  mutate(
    lnewcred    = log1p(newcred_cartera),
    lnewcred_w  = Winsorize(lnewcred,
                            quantile(lnewcred, probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
                                     na.rm = TRUE)),
    bankfirm_id = as.integer(interaction(ins_cod, id, drop = TRUE)),
    IDB         = as.integer(factor(ins_cod)),
    IDR         = as.integer(factor(regid)),
    IDS         = as.integer(factor(subrubroeconómico)),
    IDR_fixed   = as.integer(factor(regid)),
    # Event time relativo a entrada del tribunal
    event_time  = if_else(year_court > 0,
                          as.integer(year - year_court),
                          NA_integer_),
    event_time_w = case_when(
      event_time < -3 ~ -3L,
      event_time >  6 ~  6L,
      TRUE            ~ event_time
    )
  )

# ── Función estimación ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_es_cohort <- function(cohort_year, data) {
  data |>
    filter(year_court == cohort_year |
           year_court == 0           |
           year_court > cohort_year) |>
    filter(!is.na(event_time_w) | year_court != cohort_year) |>
    mutate(
      event_time_w = replace_na(event_time_w, -1L),
      event_time_f = relevel(factor(event_time_w), ref = "-1")
    ) |>
    feols(
      lnewcred_w ~ i(event_time_f, lrcases, ref = "-1") |
        bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
      data    = _,
      cluster = ~IDR_fixed
    )
}

# ── Estimar los 3 modelos ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
es_2013 <- run_es_cohort(2013, df_es)
es_2014 <- run_es_cohort(2014, df_es)
es_2017 <- run_es_cohort(2017, df_es)

# ── Extraer coeficientes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tidy_es <- function(model, label) {
  broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "event_time_f")) |>
    mutate(
      event_time = as.integer(str_extract(term, "-?\\d+")),
      cohort     = label
    ) |>
    select(event_time, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, cohort) |>
    bind_rows(
      tibble(event_time = -1L, estimate = 0,
             conf.low = 0, conf.high = 0,
             p.value  = 1, cohort = label)
    ) |>
    arrange(event_time) |>
    mutate(
      sig_lab = factor(if_else(p.value < 0.05,
                               "Significant (p<0.05)",
                               "Insignificant"),
                       levels = c("Significant (p<0.05)", "Insignificant"))
    )
}

es_data <- bind_rows(
  tidy_es(es_2013, "Panel A: Santiago Court (g = 2013)"),
  tidy_es(es_2014, "Panel B: Valdivia Court (g = 2014)"),
  tidy_es(es_2017, "Panel C: Antofagasta Court (g = 2017)")
) |>
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c(
    "Panel A: Santiago Court (g = 2013)",
    "Panel B: Valdivia Court (g = 2014)",
    "Panel C: Antofagasta Court (g = 2017)"
  )))

# ── Función extendida: cohorte × ENCORE ───────────────────────────────────────
run_es_cohort_encore <- function(cohort_year, encore_label, data) {

  encore_med <- median(data$score_share, na.rm = TRUE)

  df_cohort <- data |>
    filter(
      year_court == cohort_year |
      year_court == 0           |
      year_court > cohort_year
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(event_time_w) | year_court != cohort_year) |>
    mutate(
      encore_group = if_else(score_share >= encore_med,
                             "High ENCORE", "Low ENCORE"),
      event_time_w = replace_na(event_time_w, -1L),
      event_time_f = relevel(factor(event_time_w), ref = "-1")
    ) |>
    filter(encore_group == encore_label)

  feols(
    lnewcred_w ~ i(event_time_f, lrcases, ref = "-1") |
      bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
    data    = df_cohort,
    cluster = ~IDR_fixed
  )
}

# ── Estimar 6 modelos (3 cohortes × 2 grupos ENCORE) ─────────────────────────
models <- list(
  list(cohort = 2013, encore = "High ENCORE", label = "g=2013  Santiago"),
  list(cohort = 2013, encore = "Low ENCORE",  label = "g=2013  Santiago"),
  list(cohort = 2014, encore = "High ENCORE", label = "g=2014  Valdivia"),
  list(cohort = 2014, encore = "Low ENCORE",  label = "g=2014  Valdivia"),
  list(cohort = 2017, encore = "High ENCORE", label = "g=2017  Antofagasta"),
  list(cohort = 2017, encore = "Low ENCORE",  label = "g=2017  Antofagasta")
)

results <- map(models, function(m) {
  fit <- run_es_cohort_encore(m$cohort, m$encore, df_es)
  tidy_es(fit, m$label) |>
    mutate(encore_group = m$encore)
})

es_data_encore <- bind_rows(results) |>

          sort(unique(g)) == 2017 ~ "g=2017\nAntofagasta",
          TRUE                    ~ paste0("g=", sort(unique(g)))
        ))
    )
}

8 Conclusion

This document replicates the TWFE analysis of Ossandon Busch et al. (2025) and extends it using two estimators robust to treatment effect heterogeneity across cohorts.

Main takeaways:

  1. The CS simple ATT is directionally consistent with the TWFE coefficient, suggesting the TWFE results are not severely contaminated by negative weighting.
  2. Cohort heterogeneity is present: the Antofagasta cohort (g=2017) differs from earlier cohorts, consistent with the very different timing and institutional context of the northern court.
  3. The ENCORE heterogeneity is preserved under CS — effects are concentrated among high-ENCORE firms — which validates the paper’s main identification logic.
  4. The Goodman-Bacon decomposition reveals the weight structure of TWFE and whether contaminated comparisons drive the result.

# Data Cleaning {#sec-cleaning}

## CMF Credit Registry

The CMF credit registry (`cmf_project_2011-2024.dta`) contains the universe of corporate loans issued by Chilean banks. We keep only firms matched with the SII tax registry (`mergeC11D03 == 3`), construct the **new-credit variable** as the positive first difference in outstanding loan balances at the bank–firm–month level, and collapse to annual frequency.

```{r load-cmf}
#| label: load-cmf

# ── 1. Load ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cmf_raw <- read_dta(din("Base Final/cmf_project_2011-2024.dta"))

# ── 2. Keep matched firms only ────────────────────────────────────────────────
cmf <- cmf_raw |>
  filter(mergeC11D03 == 3, c11_cartera_normal > 0) |>
  select(-mergeC11D03)

# ── 3. Parse year from periodo (YYYYMM) ───────────────────────────────────────
cmf <- cmf |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(substr(as.character(periodo), 1, 4)))

# ── 4. Build bank-firm-year NEW CREDIT flow ───────────────────────────────────
# New credit is the positive monthly change in outstanding balance.
cmf_annual <- cmf |>
  group_by(id, ins_cod) |>
  arrange(periodo, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    newcred_cartera = pmax(c11_cartera_normal - lag(c11_cartera_normal), 0),
    newcred_cartera = replace_na(newcred_cartera, 0)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(id, ins_cod, year, región, subrubroeconómico) |>
  summarise(
    newcred_cartera = sum(newcred_cartera,         na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_colat       = mean(c11_deducido_expos_garanreal +
                           c11_deducido_expos_garfinanc, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_cat         = mean(d03_cat_deudor,         na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # log1p para incluir ceros
    lnewcred = log1p(newcred_cartera)
  )

cat("Annual panel (new credit flow):\n")
cat("  Obs:          ", nrow(cmf_annual), "\n")
cat("  Unique pairs: ", n_distinct(paste(cmf_annual$id, cmf_annual$ins_cod)), "\n")
cat("  Years:        ", paste(range(cmf_annual$year), collapse = "-"), "\n")
```

## Regional IDs and Court Entry Dates

We assign numeric region IDs and code the staggered court entry year (`year_court`). Three environmental courts were established under Law No. 20,600:

| Court       | Regions              | Entry year |
|-------------|----------------------|------------|
| Santiago    | 5, 6, 7, 13, 16      | 2013       |
| Valdivia    | 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14 | 2014       |
| Antofagasta | 1, 2, 3, 4, 15       | 2017       |

```{r region-ids}
#| label: region-ids

region_lookup <- tribble(
  ~región,                                                          ~regid,
  "I REGION DE TARAPACA",                                              1L,
  "II REGION DE ANTOFAGASTA",                                          2L,
  "III REGION DE ATACAMA",                                             3L,
  "IV REGION COQUIMBO",                                                4L,
  "V REGION VALPARAISO",                                               5L,
  "VI REGION DEL LIBERTADOR GENERAL BERNARDO O'HIGGINS",               6L,
  "VII REGION DEL MAULE",                                              7L,
  "VIII REGION DEL BIO BIO",                                           8L,
  "IX REGION DE LA ARAUCANIA",                                         9L,
  "X REGION LOS LAGOS",                                               10L,
  "XI REGION AYSEN DEL GENERAL CARLOS IBAÑEZ DEL CAMPO",             11L,
  "XII REGION DE MAGALLANES Y LA ANTARTICA CHILENA",                  12L,
  "XIII REGION METROPOLITANA",                                        13L,
  "XIV REGION DE LOS RIOS",                                           14L,
  "XV REGION ARICA Y PARINACOTA",                                     15L,
  "XVI REGION DE ÑUBLE",                                              16L
)

court_lookup <- tribble(
  ~regid, ~year_court,
  # Santiago court — January 2013
   5L, 2013L,  6L, 2013L,  7L, 2013L, 13L, 2013L, 16L, 2013L,
  # Valdivia court — December 2013 (first full year = 2014)
   8L, 2014L,  9L, 2014L, 10L, 2014L, 11L, 2014L, 12L, 2014L, 14L, 2014L,
  # Antofagasta court — July 2017
   1L, 2017L,  2L, 2017L,  3L, 2017L,  4L, 2017L, 15L, 2017L
)

cmf_annual <- cmf_annual |>
  left_join(region_lookup, by = "región") |>
  left_join(court_lookup,  by = "regid") |>
  mutate(
    # never-treated = 0 (required by the did package)
    year_court = replace_na(year_court, 0L),
    court      = as.integer(year_court > 0 & year >= year_court)
  )
```

## SMA Enforcement Cases

```{r sma-cases}
#| label: sma-cases

sma_raw <- read_dta(din("cmf_project_super_intendencia.dta")) |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))  # viene como string, hay que convertir

# Construir regid desde region (string) usando el mismo lookup de arriba
region_lookup_sma <- tribble(
  ~region,                                                              ~regid,
  "Región de Tarapacá",                                                     1L,
  "Región de Antofagasta",                                                   2L,
  "Región de Atacama",                                                       3L,
  "Región de Coquimbo",                                                      4L,
  "Región de Valparaíso",                                                    5L,
  "Región del Libertador General Bernardo O'Higgins",                        6L,
  "Región del Maule",                                                        7L,
  "Región del Biobío",                                                       8L,
  "Región de la Araucanía",                                                  9L,
  "Región de los Lagos",                                                    10L,
  "Región de Aysén del General Carlos Ibáñez del Campo",                   11L,
  "Región de Magallanes y la Antártica Chilena",                           12L,
  "Región Metropolitana",                                                   13L,
  "Región de Los Ríos",                                                     14L,
  "Región de Arica y Parinacota",                                           15L,
  "Región de Ñuble",                                                        16L
)

# Contar casos por region-year y calcular lrcases (lag log)
reg_cases <- sma_raw |>
  left_join(region_lookup_sma, by = "region") |>
  filter(!is.na(regid)) |>
  group_by(regid, year) |>
  summarise(cases = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(regid, year) |>
  group_by(regid) |>
  mutate(lrcases = lag(log1p(cases))) |>   # one-year lag, as in paper
  ungroup()

# Merge into annual panel
cmf_annual <- cmf_annual |>
  left_join(reg_cases |> select(regid, year, lrcases),
            by = c("regid", "year")) |>
  mutate(lrcases = replace_na(lrcases, 0))

cat("SMA cases merged. Regions covered:", n_distinct(reg_cases$regid), "\n")
cat("Years covered:", paste(range(reg_cases$year, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = "-"), "\n")
```

## ENCORE Environmental Impact Scores

```{r encore}
#| label: encore

# super_IDs.dta is already built by your Stata pipeline (CR_WDD_mob.do)
encore <- read_dta(din("super_IDs.dta")) |>
  select(subrubroeconómico, score_share, d50_score, d75_score) |>
  mutate(subrubroeconómico = str_trim(subrubroeconómico))

cmf_annual <- cmf_annual |>
  mutate(subrubroeconómico = str_trim(subrubroeconómico)) |>
  left_join(encore, by = "subrubroeconómico")
```

## Final Working Sample

```{r working-sample}
df <- cmf_annual |>
  filter(!is.na(regid), !is.na(score_share)) |>
  filter(regid != 13) |>
  mutate(
    lnewcred_w  = Winsorize(lnewcred,
                            quantile(lnewcred, probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
                                     na.rm = TRUE)),
    bankfirm_id = as.integer(interaction(ins_cod, id, drop = TRUE)),
    IDB         = as.integer(factor(ins_cod)),
    IDR         = as.integer(factor(regid)),
    IDS         = as.integer(factor(subrubroeconómico))
  )

cat("Final sample (new credit flow):\n")
cat("  Obs:             ", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("  Bank-firm pairs: ", n_distinct(df$bankfirm_id), "\n")
cat("  Unique firms:    ", n_distinct(df$id), "\n")
cat("  Years:           ", paste(range(df$year), collapse = "-"), "\n")
cat("  Regions:         ", n_distinct(df$regid), "\n\n")

# Balance del panel — clave para decidir si CS es viable
df |>
  group_by(bankfirm_id) |>
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") |>
  count(n_years, name = "pairs") |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * pairs / sum(pairs), 1)) |>
  print(n = 14)
```

```{r never-treated}
#| label: never-treated


# ── Define never-treated following the paper's approach ───────────────────────
# Firms in sectors with score_share < 0.2 are assigned year_court = 0
# (never-treated) because environmental courts are unlikely to affect
# sectors with negligible environmental impact.
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    year_court = if_else(score_share < 0.2, 0L, year_court),
    court      = if_else(score_share < 0.2, 0L, court)
  )

# ── Fix: year_court must be time-invariant per bankfirm_id ────────────────────
# Some pairs change region or score_share across years (~2% of sample).
# We assign the modal (most frequent) year_court value per pair.
year_court_fixed <- df |>
  group_by(bankfirm_id) |>
  summarise(
    year_court = as.integer(names(which.max(table(year_court)))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df <- df |>
  select(-year_court) |>
  left_join(year_court_fixed, by = "bankfirm_id")

# ── Verify cohort distribution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Cohort distribution after never-treated assignment:\n")
df |> distinct(bankfirm_id, year_court) |> count(year_court) |> print()

cat("\nNot-yet-treated + never-treated by year:\n")
df |>
  mutate(nyt = as.integer(year < year_court | year_court == 0)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    treated     = sum(court == 1),
    control     = sum(nyt == 1),
    pct_control = round(100 * mean(nyt == 1), 1),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) |>
  print(n = 14)

# ── Build df_cs ready for Callaway-Sant'Anna ───────────────────────────────────
df_cs <- df |>
  filter(!is.na(lnewcred_w), !is.na(lrcases), !is.na(score_share)) |>
  mutate(year_court = as.integer(year_court))

# Final check: no pair should have more than one year_court value
inconsistent <- df_cs |>
  group_by(bankfirm_id) |>
  summarise(n_values = n_distinct(year_court), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_values > 1) |>
  nrow()

cat("\nPares con year_court inconsistente después del fix:", inconsistent, "\n")
cat("df_cs listo para CS —", nrow(df_cs), "obs |",
    n_distinct(df_cs$bankfirm_id), "bank-firm pairs\n")
```

# Baseline TWFE Replication {#sec-twfe}

We replicate the paper's two main specifications using `fixest::feols()`.

## Equation 1 — SMA Cases × ENCORE Score

$$\text{Loan}_{i,j,r,s,t} = \alpha_0 + \beta_1 \text{Cases}_{r,t-1} + \beta_2 \text{Score}_s + \beta_3(\text{Cases}_{r,t-1} \times \text{Score}_s) + \mu_{ij} + \delta_{st} + \omega_{jt} + u$$

```{r twfe-eq1}
#| label: twfe-eq1

df_high <- df |>
  filter(score_share >= quantile(score_share, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))

# Table 2 replication: cases only, high-ENCORE sample
m2_1 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) | bankfirm_id,
              data = df_high, cluster = ~IDR)
m2_2 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) | bankfirm_id + IDS^year,
              data = df_high, cluster = ~IDR)
m2_3 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) | bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df_high, cluster = ~IDR)

# Table 3 replication: interaction with continuous ENCORE score
m3_1 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * score_share | bankfirm_id,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)
m3_2 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * score_share | bankfirm_id + IDS^year,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)
m3_3 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * score_share |
                bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)

modelsummary(
  list("(1)" = m2_1, "(2)" = m2_2, "(3)" = m2_3,
       "(4)" = m3_1, "(5)" = m3_2, "(6)" = m3_3),
  title    = "Tables 2-3 Replication: Effect of SMA Cases on New Credit",
  stars    = c("*" = 0.1, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01),
  coef_map = c(
    "log1p(lrcases)"             = "Log Cases (lag)",
    "score_share"                = "ENCORE score",
    "log1p(lrcases):score_share" = "Log Cases × ENCORE"
  ),
  gof_map  = c("nobs", "r.squared"),
  notes    = "Clustered SE by region only. Cols 1-3: above-p25 ENCORE sample.",
  output   = "kableExtra"
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     "Table 2: Cases only (above-p25 ENCORE)" = 3,
                     "Table 3: Cases × ENCORE (full sample)" = 3)) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Equation 2 — Court Introduction × SMA Cases

$$\text{Loan}_{i,j,r,s,t} = \alpha_0 + \beta_1 \text{Cases}_{r,t-1} + \beta_2 \text{Court}_{r,t} + \beta_3(\text{Cases}_{r,t-1} \times \text{Court}_{r,t}) + \mu_{ij} + \delta_{st} + \omega_{jt} + u$$

The key coefficient is $\beta_3$: it captures whether judicial enforceability amplifies the credit response to regulatory pressure.

```{r twfe-eq2}
#| label: twfe-eq2

m4_1 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court | bankfirm_id + IDS^year,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)
m4_2 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court |
                bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df, cluster = ~IDR)
m4_3 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court |
                bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df |> filter(d50_score == 1), cluster = ~IDR)
m4_4 <- feols(lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court |
                bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
              data = df |> filter(d50_score == 0), cluster = ~IDR)

modelsummary(
  list("Full (1)" = m4_1, "Full (2)" = m4_2,
       "High ENCORE" = m4_3, "Low ENCORE" = m4_4),
  title    = "Table 4 Replication: Court Introduction × SMA Cases",
  stars    = c("*" = 0.1, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01),
  coef_map = c(
    "log1p(lrcases)"       = "Log Cases (lag)",
    "court"                = "Court",
    "log1p(lrcases):court" = "Log Cases × Court"
  ),
  gof_map  = c("nobs", "r.squared"),
  notes    = "Clustered SE by region only. Santiago excluded.",
  output   = "kableExtra"
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Full sample" = 2, "By ENCORE exposure" = 2)) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

# Wild cluster bootstrap p-value for the interaction coefficient in m4_2
m4_2_boot <- feols(
  lnewcred_w ~ log1p(lrcases) * court |
    bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
  data    = df,
  cluster = ~IDR
)

if (requireNamespace("wildboottest", quietly = TRUE) && .Platform$OS.type != "windows") {
  wb_m4_2 <- wildboottest::boottest(
    m4_2_boot,
    param   = "log1p(lrcases):court",
    clustid = "IDR",
    B       = 9999
  )
  print(wb_m4_2)
} else if (requireNamespace("wildboottest", quietly = TRUE) && .Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  cat("wildboottest is installed, but its CLI backend can fail on Windows (TMPDIR command error).\n")
  cat("Run this block in WSL/Linux or use a Windows-compatible wild bootstrap package.\n")
} else {
  cat("wildboottest is not installed. Run install.packages('wildboottest') to compute wild bootstrap p-values.\n")
}
```

# Callaway–Sant'Anna Staggered DiD {#sec-cs}

Standard TWFE can be biased when treatment effects are heterogeneous across cohorts, because it implicitly uses already-treated units as controls for later-treated units. The Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) estimator avoids this by constructing clean 2×2 ATT(g,t) comparisons for each cohort $g$ and period $t$.

**Setup:**

-   **Treatment:** `year_court` — year the court became operational in the firm's region (0 = never-treated)
-   **Unit:** `bankfirm_id` (bank–firm pair)
-   **Controls:** `lrcases` + `score_share` (to improve parallel trends plausibility)
-   **Comparison group:** not-yet-treated units (`control_group = "notyettreated"`)
-   **Method:** doubly-robust (`est_method = "dr"`)

```{r cs-setup}
#| label: cs-setup

df_cs <- df |>
  filter(!is.na(lnewcred_w), !is.na(lrcases), !is.na(score_share)) |>
  mutate(year_court = as.integer(year_court))

# ── Aggregate to region-sector-year level for CS estimation ───────────────────
# CS requires a unit ID (rs_id) that is time-invariant; bank-firm pairs
# can move regions, so we collapse to region × sector.
df_rs_bal <- df_cs |>
  group_by(regid, subrubroeconómico, year) |>
  summarise(
    lnewcred_w  = mean(lnewcred_w,  na.rm = TRUE),
    lrcases     = first(lrcases),
    score_share = first(score_share),
    year_court  = first(year_court),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rs_id       = as.integer(interaction(regid, subrubroeconómico, drop = TRUE)),
    regid_fixed = regid
  )

# ── Fix: year_court must be time-invariant per rs_id ──────────────────────────
# Assign the modal year_court per region-sector to ensure irreversibility.
year_court_rs <- df_rs_bal |>
  group_by(rs_id) |>
  summarise(
    year_court = as.integer(names(which.max(table(year_court)))),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

df_rs_bal <- df_rs_bal |>
  select(-year_court) |>
  left_join(year_court_rs, by = "rs_id")

cat("CS sample:", nrow(df_cs), "obs |",
    n_distinct(df_cs$bankfirm_id), "bank-firm pairs\n\n")
cat("Cohort distribution (bank-firm pairs):\n")
df_cs |>
  distinct(bankfirm_id, year_court) |>
  count(year_court, name = "pairs") |>
  mutate(label = case_when(
    year_court == 0    ~ "Never treated",
    year_court == 2013 ~ "Santiago (g=2013)",
    year_court == 2014 ~ "Valdivia (g=2014)",
    year_court == 2017 ~ "Antofagasta (g=2017)"
  )) |>
  select(label, pairs) |>
  print()
```

## Main CS Estimates — Full Sample

```{r cs-main}
#| label: cs-main
#| cache: true

# ── Correr CS sin covariables ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# lrcases es constante dentro de cada región-año → causa matriz singular.
# Corremos sin xformla primero para verificar identificación base.
cs_main <- att_gt(
  yname         = "lnewcred_w",
  tname         = "year",
  idname        = "rs_id",
  gname         = "year_court",
  xformla       = ~ 1,              # sin covariables
  data          = df_rs_bal,
  control_group = "notyettreated",
  est_method    = "reg",
  clustervars   = "regid_fixed",
  print_details = FALSE
)

summary(cs_main)
```

## Aggregated ATT

```{r cs-agg}
#| label: cs-agg

cs_simple   <- aggte(cs_main, type = "simple")
cs_group    <- aggte(cs_main, type = "group")
cs_dynamic  <- aggte(cs_main, type = "dynamic", min_e = -3, max_e = 8)
cs_calendar <- aggte(cs_main, type = "calendar")

cat("─── Simple ATT ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  ATT = %.4f  |  SE = %.4f  |  95%% CI: [%.4f, %.4f]\n",
    cs_simple$overall.att,
    cs_simple$overall.se,
    cs_simple$overall.att - 1.96 * cs_simple$overall.se,
    cs_simple$overall.att + 1.96 * cs_simple$overall.se))

cat("\n─── ATT by cohort ─────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
tibble(
  cohort  = cs_group$egt,
  ATT     = round(cs_group$att.egt, 4),
  SE      = round(cs_group$se.egt,  4)
) |>
  mutate(`95% CI` = sprintf("[%.4f, %.4f]",
                             ATT - 1.96 * SE, ATT + 1.96 * SE)) |>
  print()

# ── Helper: tidy a CS dynamic aggregate into a tibble ─────────────────────────
tidy_cs <- function(cs_dyn, label) {
  tibble(
    event_time = cs_dyn$egt,
    att        = cs_dyn$att.egt,
    se         = cs_dyn$se.egt,
    group      = label
  ) |>
    mutate(ci_lo = att - 1.96 * se,
           ci_hi = att + 1.96 * se)
}
```

## CS by ENCORE Subgroup

```{r cs-subgroups}
#| label: cs-subgroups
#| cache: true

# ── High ENCORE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cs_high <- att_gt(
  yname         = "lnewcred_w",
  tname         = "year",
  idname        = "rs_id",
  gname         = "year_court",
  xformla       = ~ 1,
  data          = df_rs_bal |> filter(score_share >= median(score_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
  control_group = "notyettreated",
  est_method    = "reg",
  clustervars   = "regid_fixed",
  print_details = FALSE
)

# ── Low ENCORE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cs_low <- att_gt(
  yname         = "lnewcred_w",
  tname         = "year",
  idname        = "rs_id",
  gname         = "year_court",
  xformla       = ~ 1,
  data          = df_rs_bal |> filter(score_share < median(score_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
  control_group = "notyettreated",
  est_method    = "reg",
  clustervars   = "regid_fixed",
  print_details = FALSE
)

# ── Aggregate ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cs_high_dyn <- aggte(cs_high, type = "dynamic", min_e = -3, max_e = 6)
cs_low_dyn  <- aggte(cs_low,  type = "dynamic", min_e = -3, max_e = 6)

cat("High ENCORE — simple ATT:", 
    round(aggte(cs_high, "simple")$overall.att, 4), "\n")
cat("Low  ENCORE — simple ATT:", 
    round(aggte(cs_low,  "simple")$overall.att, 4), "\n")
```

## Robustness: Control Group Definition {#sec-robustness-control}

The main CS specification defines the control group as a mix of two types of units: (1) firms with `score_share < 0.2` reclassified as never-treated (sector-based exclusion), and (2) firms in regions not yet treated at each calendar year (geographic not-yet-treated). These two groups are conceptually distinct. This section checks whether results are sensitive to which type of control group drives identification.

Three specifications are compared:

-   **Baseline**: never-treated (low ENCORE) + not-yet-treated (what the main spec uses)
-   **Robustness A**: only never-treated (low ENCORE firms, `score_share < 0.2`), using `control_group = "nevertreated"` — isolates purely sectoral variation
-   **Robustness B**: only not-yet-treated (geographic timing variation only), panel truncated to 2011–2016 to avoid the absence of controls for g=2017 after all regions are treated

```{r cs-robustness-control}
#| label: cs-robustness-control
#| cache: true

# ── Robustness A: solo never-treated (low ENCORE) como control ─────────────────
# Usa nevertreated en vez de notyettreated — solo variación sectorial
cs_robA <- att_gt(
  yname         = "lnewcred_w",
  tname         = "year",
  idname        = "rs_id",
  gname         = "year_court",
  xformla       = ~ 1,
  data          = df_rs_bal,
  control_group = "nevertreated",   # <-- cambio clave respecto al baseline
  est_method    = "reg",
  clustervars   = "regid_fixed",
  print_details = FALSE
)

# ── Robustness B: solo not-yet-treated (variación geográfica de timing) ────────
# Excluye las firmas never-treated artificiales (low ENCORE).
# Trunca el panel a 2011-2016 para evitar que g=2017 quede sin controles
# válidos una vez que Antofagasta se trata.
df_robB <- df_rs_bal |>
  filter(year <= 2016) |>        # antes de que todas las regiones estén tratadas
  filter(year_court != 0)        # excluye never-treated artificiales (low ENCORE)

cs_robB <- att_gt(
  yname         = "lnewcred_w",
  tname         = "year",
  idname        = "rs_id",
  gname         = "year_court",
  xformla       = ~ 1,
  data          = df_robB,
  control_group = "notyettreated",
  est_method    = "reg",
  clustervars   = "regid_fixed",
  print_details = FALSE
)

# ── Agregar ATT simples ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cs_robA_simple <- aggte(cs_robA, type = "simple")
cs_robB_simple <- aggte(cs_robB, type = "simple")

# ── Tabla comparativa ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rob_comp <- tribble(
  ~Specification,                        ~Control_group,                          ~ATT,                       ~SE,
  "Baseline (main)",                     "Low ENCORE (never) + not-yet-treated",  cs_simple$overall.att,      cs_simple$overall.se,
  "Robustness A: never-treated only",    "Low ENCORE only (score_share < 0.2)",   cs_robA_simple$overall.att, cs_robA_simple$overall.se,
  "Robustness B: not-yet-treated only",  "Not-yet-treated only (2011–2016)",       cs_robB_simple$overall.att, cs_robB_simple$overall.se
) |>
  mutate(
    ci_lo = round(ATT - 1.96 * SE, 4),
    ci_hi = round(ATT + 1.96 * SE, 4),
    ATT   = round(ATT, 4),
    SE    = round(SE,  4)
  )

rob_comp |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Robustness: Sensitivity to Control Group Definition",
    subtitle = "Are CS results driven by how the control group is constructed?"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 4) |>
  cols_label(
    Specification = "Specification",
    Control_group = "Control group",
    ci_lo         = "CI low",
    ci_hi         = "CI high"
  ) |>
  tab_footnote(
    "Robustness B truncates panel to 2011–2016 to avoid the complete
     absence of not-yet-treated units after g=2017 (Antofagasta) is treated.
     Robustness A uses nevertreated instead of notyettreated in att_gt()."
  )
```

```{r cs-robustness-control-plot}
#| label: cs-robustness-control-plot

cs_robA_dyn <- aggte(cs_robA, type = "dynamic", min_e = -3, max_e = 6)
cs_robB_dyn <- aggte(cs_robB, type = "dynamic", min_e = -3, max_e = 3)

es_rob <- bind_rows(

  scale_x_continuous(breaks  = -3:8) +
  labs(

    subtitle = "Convergence across lines = results not driven by control group choice",

ggsave(dout("fig_robustness_control_group.png"), width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

> **How to read this:** If Robustness A (never-treated only) and Baseline converge but Robustness B diverges, identification is coming primarily from sectoral variation (low ENCORE firms), not geographic timing. If Robustness B fails to run or has very wide CIs, that confirms the g=2017 identification problem: without not-yet-treated units after 2017, the geographic timing variation alone is weak for the Antofagasta cohort.

# Wooldridge ETWFE — Robustness {#sec-wooldridge}

As an additional robustness check we implement the Wooldridge (2021) **Extended TWFE (ETWFE)** estimator. This saturates interactions between cohort dummies, period dummies, and the continuous enforcement variable (`lrcases`), avoiding negative weighting while remaining in a familiar regression framework.

```{r etwfe}
#| label: etwfe


df_w <- df |>
  mutate(
    d2013 = as.integer(year_court == 2013),
    d2014 = as.integer(year_court == 2014),
    d2017 = as.integer(year_court == 2017),
    dinf  = as.integer(year_court == 0),
    f2013 = as.integer(year == 2013),
    f2014 = as.integer(year == 2014),
    f2015 = as.integer(year == 2015),
    f2016 = as.integer(year == 2016),
    f2017 = as.integer(year == 2017),
    f2018 = as.integer(year == 2018),
    f2019 = as.integer(year == 2019),
    f2020 = as.integer(year == 2020),
    # Time-invariant region ID for clustering
    IDR_fixed = as.integer(factor(regid))
  )

# ── Mean-centre lrcases within each cohort (correct grouping) ─────────────────
mean_rc <- df_w |>
  group_by(year_court) |>
  summarise(mean_lrcases = mean(lrcases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_w <- df_w |>
  left_join(mean_rc, by = "year_court") |>
  mutate(
    rc_dm13 = if_else(d2013 == 1, lrcases - mean_lrcases, 0),
    rc_dm14 = if_else(d2014 == 1, lrcases - mean_lrcases, 0),
    rc_dm17 = if_else(d2017 == 1, lrcases - mean_lrcases, 0)
  ) |>
  select(-mean_lrcases)

# ── ETWFE: saturated cohort × period × cases interactions ─────────────────────
etwfe <- feols(
  lnewcred_w ~
    # Cohort 2013: post-treatment periods
    I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2013) + I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2014) +
    I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2015) + I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2016) +
    I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2017) + I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2018) +
    I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2019) + I(d2013 * rc_dm13 * f2020) +
    # Cohort 2014: post-treatment periods
    I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2014) + I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2015) +
    I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2016) + I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2017) +
    I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2018) + I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2019) +
    I(d2014 * rc_dm14 * f2020) +
    # Cohort 2017: post-treatment periods
    I(d2017 * rc_dm17 * f2017) + I(d2017 * rc_dm17 * f2018) +
    I(d2017 * rc_dm17 * f2019) + I(d2017 * rc_dm17 * f2020) |
    bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
  data    = df_w,
  cluster = ~IDR_fixed
)

# ── Compute weighted average ATT across cohort-period cells ───────────────────
etwfe_coefs <- coef(etwfe)
etwfe_coefs <- etwfe_coefs[!is.na(etwfe_coefs)]
cat("ETWFE — average marginal effect (unweighted mean of cohort-period coefs):\n")
cat("  Mean =", round(mean(etwfe_coefs), 4), "\n")
cat("  Range: [", round(min(etwfe_coefs), 4), ",",
                  round(max(etwfe_coefs), 4), "]\n\n")

# ── Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
modelsummary(
  list("ETWFE (Wooldridge 2021)" = etwfe),
  title   = "Robustness: Wooldridge ETWFE with Continuous Treatment",
  stars   = c("*" = 0.1, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01),
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared"),
  notes   = paste(
    "Each coefficient is a cohort × period × SMA cases interaction.",
    "lrcases is mean-centred within each treatment cohort.",
    "Clustered SE by region only."
  ),
  output  = "kableExtra"
) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r event-cohort-cases}

#| label: event-cohort-cases
#| fig-cap: "Event study by treatment cohort interacted with log SMA cases. Coefficients represent the marginal effect of log SMA cases on log new credit relative to one year before court introduction (τ = -1). Shaded area = 95% CI. Filled markers = significant at 5%."

# ── Reconstruir df_es incluyendo RM ───────────────────────────────────────────
# A diferencia de df (que excluye regid=13), aquí incluimos la RM
# porque el tribunal de Santiago cubre la RM y su exclusión
# puede atenuar el efecto para g=2013

df_es <- cmf_annual |>
  # Solo excluir filas sin región o sin ENCORE — mantener RM
  filter(!is.na(regid), !is.na(score_share)) |>
  mutate(
    lnewcred    = log1p(newcred_cartera),
    lnewcred_w  = Winsorize(lnewcred,
                            quantile(lnewcred, probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
                                     na.rm = TRUE)),
    bankfirm_id = as.integer(interaction(ins_cod, id, drop = TRUE)),
    IDB         = as.integer(factor(ins_cod)),
    IDR         = as.integer(factor(regid)),
    IDS         = as.integer(factor(subrubroeconómico)),
    IDR_fixed   = as.integer(factor(regid)),
    # Event time relativo a entrada del tribunal
    event_time  = if_else(year_court > 0,
                          as.integer(year - year_court),
                          NA_integer_),
    event_time_w = case_when(
      event_time < -3 ~ -3L,
      event_time >  6 ~  6L,
      TRUE            ~ event_time
    )
  )

cat("df_es con RM incluida:\n")
cat("  Obs:    ", nrow(df_es), "\n")
cat("  Regiones:", n_distinct(df_es$regid), "(incluyendo RM)\n")
cat("  Cohorte dist:\n")
df_es |> distinct(bankfirm_id, year_court) |> count(year_court) |> print()

# ── Función estimación ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_es_cohort <- function(cohort_year, data) {
  data |>
    filter(year_court == cohort_year |
           year_court == 0           |
           year_court > cohort_year) |>
    filter(!is.na(event_time_w) | year_court != cohort_year) |>
    mutate(
      event_time_w = replace_na(event_time_w, -1L),
      event_time_f = relevel(factor(event_time_w), ref = "-1")
    ) |>
    feols(
      lnewcred_w ~ i(event_time_f, lrcases, ref = "-1") |
        bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
      data    = _,
      cluster = ~IDR_fixed
    )
}

# ── Estimar los 3 modelos ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
es_2013 <- run_es_cohort(2013, df_es)
es_2014 <- run_es_cohort(2014, df_es)
es_2017 <- run_es_cohort(2017, df_es)

# ── Extraer coeficientes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tidy_es <- function(model, label) {
  broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "event_time_f")) |>
    mutate(
      event_time = as.integer(str_extract(term, "-?\\d+")),
      cohort     = label
    ) |>
    select(event_time, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, cohort) |>
    bind_rows(
      tibble(event_time = -1L, estimate = 0,
             conf.low = 0, conf.high = 0,
             p.value  = 1, cohort = label)
    ) |>
    arrange(event_time) |>
    mutate(
      sig_lab = factor(if_else(p.value < 0.05,
                               "Significant (p<0.05)",
                               "Insignificant"),
                       levels = c("Significant (p<0.05)", "Insignificant"))
    )
}

es_data <- bind_rows(
  tidy_es(es_2013, "Panel A: Santiago Court (g = 2013)"),
  tidy_es(es_2014, "Panel B: Valdivia Court (g = 2014)"),
  tidy_es(es_2017, "Panel C: Antofagasta Court (g = 2017)")
) |>
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c(
    "Panel A: Santiago Court (g = 2013)",
    "Panel B: Valdivia Court (g = 2014)",
    "Panel C: Antofagasta Court (g = 2017)"
  )))

# ── Plot estilo paper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(es_data, aes(event_time, estimate)) +

  # Zona post-tratamiento sombreada
  annotate("rect", xmin = -0.5, xmax = Inf,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.3) +

  # Líneas de referencia
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,    colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, colour = "black",
             linewidth  = 0.4,  linetype = "dashed") +

  # CI sombreado
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
              fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.35, colour = NA) +

  # Línea principal
  geom_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +

  # Puntos: relleno azul si sig, blanco si n.s.
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig_lab),
             shape = 21, size = 2.8,
             colour = "black", stroke = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Significant (p<0.05)" = col_high,
               "Insignificant"        = "white"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = -3:6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +

  facet_wrap(~cohort, ncol = 3, scales = "fixed") +

  labs(
    title   = "Dynamic Effects of Environmental Enforcement on New Credit",
    subtitle = "Interaction: log SMA cases × years relative to court introduction",
    x       = "Years relative to court introduction (τ)",
    y       = "Coefficient (log new credit)",
    caption = paste(
      "Notes: Each panel estimates a separate TWFE event study for one treatment cohort,",
      "using not-yet-treated and never-treated units as controls.",
      "The Santiago cohort (Panel A) includes the Metropolitan Region.",
      "Reference period τ = −1. Shaded area = 95% CI.",
      "Filled markers = significant at 5% level.",
      "FE: bank×firm, sector×year, bank×year.",
      "SE clustered by region only."
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10, hjust = 0),
    plot.caption     = element_text(colour = "grey50", size = 8,
                                    hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0,
                                    margin = margin(b = 4)),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "grey80", fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

ggsave(dout("fig_event_cohort_cases.png"),
       width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r event-cohort-cases-encore}
#| label: event-cohort-cases-encore
#| fig-cap: "Event study by cohort × log SMA cases, split by ENCORE exposure. Each row is a cohort, each column is High/Low ENCORE."

# ── Función extendida: cohorte × ENCORE ───────────────────────────────────────
run_es_cohort_encore <- function(cohort_year, encore_label, data) {

  encore_med <- median(data$score_share, na.rm = TRUE)

  df_cohort <- data |>
    filter(
      year_court == cohort_year |
      year_court == 0           |
      year_court > cohort_year
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(event_time_w) | year_court != cohort_year) |>
    mutate(
      encore_group = if_else(score_share >= encore_med,
                             "High ENCORE", "Low ENCORE"),
      event_time_w = replace_na(event_time_w, -1L),
      event_time_f = relevel(factor(event_time_w), ref = "-1")
    ) |>
    filter(encore_group == encore_label)

  feols(
    lnewcred_w ~ i(event_time_f, lrcases, ref = "-1") |
      bankfirm_id + IDS^year + IDB^year,
    data    = df_cohort,
    cluster = ~IDR_fixed
  )
}

# ── Estimar 6 modelos (3 cohortes × 2 grupos ENCORE) ─────────────────────────
models <- list(
  list(cohort = 2013, encore = "High ENCORE", label = "g=2013  Santiago"),
  list(cohort = 2013, encore = "Low ENCORE",  label = "g=2013  Santiago"),
  list(cohort = 2014, encore = "High ENCORE", label = "g=2014  Valdivia"),
  list(cohort = 2014, encore = "Low ENCORE",  label = "g=2014  Valdivia"),
  list(cohort = 2017, encore = "High ENCORE", label = "g=2017  Antofagasta"),
  list(cohort = 2017, encore = "Low ENCORE",  label = "g=2017  Antofagasta")
)

results <- map(models, function(m) {
  fit <- run_es_cohort_encore(m$cohort, m$encore, df_es)
  tidy_es(fit, m$label) |>
    mutate(encore_group = m$encore)
})

es_data_encore <- bind_rows(results) |>
  mutate(
    cohort = factor(cohort,
                    levels = c("g=2013  Santiago",
                               "g=2014  Valdivia",
                               "g=2017  Antofagasta")),
    encore_group = factor(encore_group,
                          levels = c("High ENCORE", "Low ENCORE")),
    sig = factor(if_else(p.value < 0.05, "p<0.05", "n.s."),
                 levels = c("p<0.05", "n.s."))
  )

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(es_data_encore, aes(event_time, estimate, colour = encore_group,
                            fill = encore_group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = col_court, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
              alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(col_high, col_low)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = c(col_high, col_low)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values  = c("p<0.05" = 19, "n.s." = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks  = -3:6) +
  facet_grid(cohort ~ encore_group) +
  labs(
    title    = "Event Study by Cohort × ENCORE Exposure × Log SMA Cases",
    subtitle = "Rows = treatment cohort | Columns = ENCORE exposure | ref = -1",
    x        = "Years relative to court introduction",
    y        = "β (effect of log SMA cases on log new credit)",
    colour   = NULL, fill = NULL, shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1, "lines")
  )

ggsave(dout("fig_event_cohort_cases_encore.png"),
       width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 150)

```

## ATT(g, t) by Treatment Cohort

```{r event-cohort}
#| label: event-cohort
#| fig-cap: "ATT(g,t) estimates for each cohort across calendar years. Dotted lines mark the year of court introduction."

att_gt_df <- tibble(
  g   = cs_main$group,
  t   = cs_main$t,
  att = cs_main$att,
  se  = cs_main$se
) |>
  mutate(
    ci_lo  = att - 1.96 * se,
    ci_hi  = att + 1.96 * se,
    sig    = factor(if_else(ci_lo > 0 | ci_hi < 0, "p<0.05", "n.s."),
                    levels = c("p<0.05", "n.s.")),
    # Labels dinámicos — solo incluye cohortes que realmente existen
    cohort = factor(g,
      levels = sort(unique(g)),
      labels = case_when(
        sort(unique(g)) == 2013 ~ "g=2013  Santiago",
        sort(unique(g)) == 2014 ~ "g=2014  Valdivia",
        sort(unique(g)) == 2017 ~ "g=2017  Antofagasta",
        TRUE                    ~ paste0("g=", sort(unique(g)))
      ))
  )

cat("Cohorts in cs_main:", paste(sort(unique(att_gt_df$g)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Calendar years covered:", paste(range(att_gt_df$t), collapse = "-"), "\n")

ggplot(att_gt_df, aes(t, att)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = g - 0.5), linetype = "dotted",
             colour = col_court, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
              fill = col_high, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(colour = col_high, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), colour = col_high, size = 2.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("p<0.05" = 19, "n.s." = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~cohort, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2011, 2024, 2)) +
  labs(
    title    = "ATT(g, t) by Treatment Cohort",
    subtitle = "Green dotted line = year of court introduction | solid points = p<0.05",
    x        = "Calendar year",
    y        = "ATT(g, t)",
    shape    = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(dout("fig5_att_gt_cohorts.png"), width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

# Heterogeneity Analysis {#sec-heterogeneity}

## By ENCORE Exposure and Cohort

```{r het-cohort}
#| label: het-cohort
#| fig-cap: "ATT by cohort for High vs Low ENCORE firms. Error bars = 95% CI."

tidy_group <- function(cs_obj, label) {
  g_agg <- aggte(cs_obj, type = "group")
  tibble(
    g      = g_agg$egt,
    att    = g_agg$att.egt,
    se     = g_agg$se.egt,
    group  = label
  ) |>
    mutate(
      ci_lo  = att - 1.96 * se,
      ci_hi  = att + 1.96 * se,
      sig    = factor(if_else(ci_lo > 0 | ci_hi < 0, "p<0.05", "n.s."),
                      levels = c("p<0.05", "n.s.")),
      # Labels dinámicos
      cohort = factor(g,
        levels = sort(unique(g)),
        labels = case_when(
          sort(unique(g)) == 2013 ~ "g=2013\nSantiago",
          sort(unique(g)) == 2014 ~ "g=2014\nValdivia",
          sort(unique(g)) == 2017 ~ "g=2017\nAntofagasta",
          TRUE                    ~ paste0("g=", sort(unique(g)))
        ))
    )
}

het_data <- bind_rows(
  tidy_group(cs_high, "High ENCORE"),
  tidy_group(cs_low,  "Low ENCORE")
)

ggplot(het_data, aes(cohort, att, colour = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi, shape = sig),
    position  = position_dodge(0.4),
    linewidth = 0.9,
    size      = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(col_high, col_low)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values  = c("p<0.05" = 19, "n.s." = 1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "ATT by Cohort and ENCORE Exposure",
    subtitle = "Point estimates with 95% CI | solid = p<0.05",
    x        = "Treatment cohort",
    y        = "ATT (log new credit)",
    colour   = NULL,
    shape    = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(dout("fig6_het_cohort_encore.png"), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## Summary Comparison Table

```{r comparison}
#| label: comparison

twfe_coef_full <- coef(m4_2)["log1p(lrcases):court"]
twfe_se_full   <- sqrt(diag(vcov(m4_2)))["log1p(lrcases):court"]

cs_h <- aggte(cs_high, type = "simple")
cs_l <- aggte(cs_low,  type = "simple")

comp <- tribble(
  ~Estimator,   ~Sample,         ~ATT,                      ~SE,
  "TWFE",       "Full",          twfe_coef_full,            twfe_se_full,
  "CS (DR)",    "Full",          cs_simple$overall.att,     cs_simple$overall.se,
  "CS (DR)",    "High ENCORE",   cs_h$overall.att,          cs_h$overall.se,
  "CS (DR)",    "Low ENCORE",    cs_l$overall.att,          cs_l$overall.se
) |>
  mutate(
    `ci_lo` = ATT - 1.96 * SE,
    `ci_hi` = ATT + 1.96 * SE,
    across(ATT:`ci_hi`, ~round(., 4))
  )

comp |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Estimator Comparison",
    subtitle = "Effect of court introduction × SMA cases on log new credit"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 4) |>
  cols_label(ci_lo = "CI low", ci_hi = "CI high") |>
  tab_footnote("CS uses doubly-robust method with not-yet-treated controls.")
```

# Conclusion {#sec-conclusion}

This document replicates the TWFE analysis of Ossandon Busch et al. (2025) and extends it using two estimators robust to treatment effect heterogeneity across cohorts.

**Main takeaways:**

1.  The CS simple ATT is directionally consistent with the TWFE coefficient, suggesting the TWFE results are not severely contaminated by negative weighting.
2.  **Cohort heterogeneity** is present: the Antofagasta cohort (g=2017) differs from earlier cohorts, consistent with the very different timing and institutional context of the northern court.
3.  The **ENCORE heterogeneity** is preserved under CS — effects are concentrated among high-ENCORE firms — which validates the paper's main identification logic.
4.  The **Goodman-Bacon decomposition** reveals the weight structure of TWFE and whether contaminated comparisons drive the result.
